title: Skill Tail Rake
wikitext:
{{expand}}
An '''Iksar''' [[Monk]] special attack. Tail Rake is trainable at level 25, where it replaces [[Eagle Strike]] as the Monk special punch attack. It is the last punch attack Monks get during the Classic Era.

Human Monks get [[Skill Dragon Punch|Dragon Punch]] instead.
